name: Adult Migrant English Program (AMEP)
provider: Department of Home Affairs (via Services Australia)
summary: Free English classes for eligible migrants who speak little or no English, run by providers including many TAFEs.
who: Aged 18 or over and speak little or no English.
Permanent residents, holders of an eligible temporary visa, and some citizens who held an eligible visa before.
People aged 15 to 17 may be able to do AMEP, even if they go to school.
how: Find an AMEP provider on the Department of Home Affairs website and register with them.
catches: If you arrived after 1 October 2020 and are 18 or older, you must register with an AMEP provider within 6 months.
If you have children under school age, you may get free child care while you attend face-to-face classes.
